newsitem.title: BOLIVIA: Bolivia Nov inflation 0.51 pct vs 1.79 pct Nov 95.
newsitem.headline: Bolivia Nov inflation 0.51 pct vs 1.79 pct Nov 95.

text.p: Bolivia's consumer prices rose 0.51 percent in November, down from 1.79 percent in November 1995 but up from 0.07 percent deflation in October, the National Statistics Institute said Tuesday.
Inflation in the January-November period was 7.77 percent, down from 10.59 percent over the same period 1995.
In the 12 months to November, consumer prices rose 9.71 percent versus 10.74 percent in the 12 months to November 1995.
The government has forecast 8.0-8.5 percent inflation this year. The institute does not provide wholesale inflation data.
